tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Busemann sublevel sets and the Busemann function] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0323, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0324 ↗ appb-def-busemann-sublevel 1. Lemma B.59\group comparison-theorems

For the Busemann function $\bar b$ associated to $O$, one has $C_s=\{ x:\bar b(x)\le s\} $. In particular, the sets $C_s$ are nested and their boundaries are the level sets of $\bar b$.
